basic_details.job_title: B.B. College Female Warden Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Banwarilal Bhalotia College, Asansol (a constituent college of Kazi Nazrul University) has advertised one vacancy for Female Warden of its Girls' Hostel. Applications, with a detailed biodata and supporting testimonials, must be submitted to the Office of the Principal, B.B. College, Asansol, by 5 December 2026 up to 4:00 p.m. The candidate must hold a Bachelor's Degree and be 35 years or above.

qualification.details: The notice advertises one post: Warden of the Girls' Hostel, advertised as Female Warden. | Educational qualification: Bachelor's Degree (Graduation) from a recognised University. Age: 35 years or above. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no relaxation. Residence: the selected candidate shall reside within the Girls' Hostel premises and discharge the assigned responsibilities accordingly. Pay: free boarding and lodging facilities will be provided by the College Authority. No salary amount is printed. | Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

important_instructions: The selected candidate is required to live inside the Girls' Hostel premises. The notice states that the posting is for engagement as Warden of the Girls' Hostel, B.B. College, Asansol.
